name: Rentrée Gourmande - Carrefour France
notes: Back-to-school premium campaign with gondola-end display in 840 stores. Starts one day before PLANT-FR-01 depletes pectin, so the uplift arrives precisely when supply disappears. Media spend is already committed and non-refundable after 2026-09-07. Suspension decision required within 4 days.

name: Kids Pouch Family Pack - E.Leclerc
notes: Highest forecast uplift of any campaign in the window at 41%, on a SKU produced exclusively on the single Kids pouch line at Rennes. The 21-day pre-notification rule means the retailer must be told by 2026-09-05 if this is to be suspended cleanly.

name: Herbstgenuss Dessert-Wochen - REWE
notes: Autumn dessert campaign starting 17 days after PLANT-DE-02 depletes. Recoverable if alternate supply from SUP-EU-023 lands within the 21-day lead time, otherwise it must be suspended. REWE contract also carries the supplier-emissions improvement clause, so a high-carbon emergency source creates a second problem on the same account.

name: Bio-Joghurt Aktionswochen - EDEKA
notes: Organic-positioned campaign on the largest Bremen SKU. Because the SKU is EU organic certified it cannot be reformulated onto amidated LM pectin, so the only way to protect this promotion is alternate organic-certified supply from SUP-EU-023.

name: Belgian Dessert Festival - Delhaize
notes: Features the two highest-margin SKUs at Ghent. Direct conflict with the production plan, which nominates SKU-YOG-010 as a decampaigning candidate. Either the promotion is descoped to SKU-DES-001 alone or the decampaigning decision is reversed.

name: Private Label Value Drive - Colruyt
notes: Far enough out that alternate supply should have landed, but the private-label contract termination clause means fill-rate performance in Q4 is unusually consequential. Keep under review rather than suspending now.

name: Lait Frais Quotidien - Intermarché
notes: Unaffected by the pectin incident because neither SKU contains ING-PEC-450. Actively useful as a shelf-space defence: additional plain yogurt and milk facings can absorb display space vacated by out-of-stock fruited variants.

name: Protein Autumn Challenge - Metro
notes: Half the campaign is on the pectin-free SKU-YOG-012, which is produced at the unaffected Zaragoza site. Recommendation is to reweight the campaign onto SKU-YOG-012 and drop SKU-YOG-008 rather than suspend it, preserving the media spend and the retailer relationship.
